name: Charlotte SerenGarand
source:
The orphaned daughter of General Ares, who gave his life for his country 14 years ago, endowed in swordplay, aggressive, strong, and overwhelmingly capable of leadership and affinity, Charlotte has inherited almost all the virtues from her father. Despite being a daughter, she has always seen herself as a man. A natural warm-hearted person, often actively trying to help others, and consider things from the standpoint of others. With a sharp intuition like an animal, the typical action-oriented, very easily swayed by subjective feelings.
She has always been a gentleman to the girls around her, and is an absolute feminist, although she seems to have a good relationship with the princesses, she still keeps a certain distance for some reason and seems to act alone more often than with the princesses, and people who are familiar with her sometimes say that she is a person who "will do whatever it takes to get what she wants. Although she is action-oriented and lacks patience, but Charlotte is quite good at mechanical repairs that require a high rate of accuracy, especially the repair of clocks and watches. Her keen sense of smell makes her sensitive to fragrance, and she has her own insights into the preparation of essential oils and perfumes, a specialty she is said to have been given by her mother.
